scope: Record the prepared JCS prayer-map correction, persistent historical Nexus, separate owner HTML source viewer and explicit reasoning/workflow preferences. This publication changes the continuity repository only.

target.branch_before_future_write: verify current branch/head when a write is requested
target.delivery: User manually commits the complete accepted HTML unless explicitly requesting application commit/deployment.

accepted_artifacts.role: separate owner source viewer; exports prayer.map.html

source_selection.base: Latest accepted prayer.map(4).html, originally saved version 2; corrected public candidate saved as version 4.
source_selection.avoid: Older pasted text lacked the accepted timeline. Do not rebuild from it or substitute an older live/repository version. Retrieve the latest user-accepted file and compare hashes before resuming.
source_selection.recover: Recover saved complete artifacts by filename/date/hash; scratch paths are transient. If a later user version exists, inspect it first and preserve its changes. The embedded source in the owner viewer can recover the public HTML; do not use a runtime DOM serialization.

public_interface.source_controls: Removed View code / Copy full HTML / Download HTML and their self-source payload from the public application.
public_interface.data_tools: Existing JSON/protocol exports moved to a collapsed Additional data tools footer drawer; handlers and IDs retained.
public_interface.map: Larger responsive viewport; zoom +/−, pan, reset, expand/close, keyboard navigation and touch pinch; wheel zoom after engagement or Ctrl wheel.
public_interface.preserve: Existing topology, annual datasets, UCDP/GDELT, prayer/privacy thresholds, read-only XRPL/NFT layers and established JCS design/identity.

owner_viewer.source: Self-contained base64 UTF-8 snapshot of the exact complete public file; regenerate after every edit.
owner_viewer.copy_fallback: Read-only full-source textarea supports manual selection and copying if clipboard access fails.
owner_viewer.preview_only_base: https://jesuschristsavestoken.com/ is injected into iframe preview only; copied/downloaded bytes remain the original public source.
owner_viewer.boundary: Owner convenience, not authentication or confidentiality. Controls are outside the exported public page. An HTML page that displays the code is acceptable; no Inspect Element step should be required.

timeline.meaning: Selected sourced chronology, not a fabricated annual persecution series or an exhaustive history. Preserve dated/approximate/traditional labels and source links; early years without records have no invented scores. Modern geography is orientation only.
timeline.live_layers: Prayer/live reports and optional recent overlay remain distinct from historical evidence.

historical_nexus.intent: Opposing suffering and support converge; accumulated Nexus points remain as the map advances.
historical_nexus.visual: Inward red/green particles, opposing arcs, expanding waves, glow and a gold cross/core.
historical_nexus.reference: PLAYBACK-BATTLE-NEXUS-2026-09-23.md supplies the prior opposing-stream visual concept; its trading depth, stale-data rules and market interpretation do not transfer to historical Christianity.
historical_nexus.birth_rule: A region appears only when dated evidence from both red and green categories exists at or before the selected year.
historical_nexus.persistence: Retain keyed SVG DOM nodes for both historical markers and Nexus regions. Forward progression updates evidence without recreating nodes. Rewind hides future points/evidence; forward restores cached nodes.
historical_nexus.interaction: Keyboard-accessible selection opens both dated event lists; milestone selection opens source details.
historical_nexus.motion: Reduced-motion CSS stops animation; animations pause when the document is hidden. No new dedicated animation pause control was added.
historical_nexus.export: jcs-history-state includes historicalNexus with region IDs, birth/through years, evidence event IDs, positions and method; JSON export retains chronology, original annual data and historical context.
historical_nexus.meaning_boundary: Symbolic competition/tension between recorded themes. Persistence does not establish ongoing conflict, causation, travel routes or relative strength. No numerical force score is inferred.

implementation_recovery.availability: These scratch helpers may expire; their delivered executable/data content is embedded in the complete public HTML. Do not depend on helper paths surviving.
implementation_recovery.integration: Single authoritative existing setViewBox; navigation uses jcs:set-map-viewbox. createHistoricalNexus integrates with chronology rather than rebuilding the map each frame.

verification.provenance: Results already completed during the page-edit task; reused here without rerunning application tests.
verification.inline_javascript: 8 executable blocks parse; embedded JSON parses.
verification.focused_module_harness: Passed mocked-DOM checks of onset years, retained node identity, rewind/restore, evidence categories, Nexus selection/source drilldown and history export.
verification.owner_source_payload: Decoded embedded public HTML matched the delivered public file byte-for-byte.
verification.browser_rendering: not verified; Playwright Chromium executable unavailable and installer failed with invalid/empty archive

reasoning_preference.source: Explicit user instruction while requesting this GitHub AI checkpoint.
reasoning_preference.checkpoint_work: User prefers Ultra for creating and reconciling memory/checkpoints, even when the task is not technically complex.
reasoning_preference.page_work: User intends to return to very high or another lower reasoning setting for ordinary page work.
reasoning_preference.boundary: User workflow preference, not a capability ranking or automatic model-setting change; use the actual available setting and current instructions.
reasoning_preference.format: Readable text, structured JSON and concise code are acceptable. Prefer precise recoverable state over opaque shorthand or repeated transcripts.

known_blocker.condition: No usable browser runtime in this page-edit workspace; installer returned invalid/empty archive.
known_blocker.resume_when: New evidence of an available working browser/runtime, not merely a repeated prompt or new session.
known_blocker.independent_work: Manual HTML handoff and requested memory publication can continue.

resume: Read this compact checkpoint and recover the latest accepted complete artifact.
Apply only the next requested page change; preserve the owner/public separation, full chronology and persistent evidence-based Nexus.
Regenerate the owner payload whenever public HTML changes.
Reuse recorded checks; perform only a required gate or focused check for a concrete new risk.
Return complete files for user commit; application commit/deployment requires that explicit request.
preserved_queue: Legacy XRBC/XRB queue and Bing/ecosystem/Creature/tokenization handoffs are unchanged and resume only when their topic is requested.
source_commit_scope: Inherited legacy XRBC/frontend and shared-backend snapshots solely for continuity with the repository schema. Not newly observed here, not JCS source commits, and not evidence of deploying these artifacts.
